info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Retail Orders Tracks-v3-spec
info.description: The Retail Order Tracking API allows users to retrieve detailed tracking information for retail orders. It serves as a critical resource for businesses looking to keep customers informed about their orders' status and location. Retailers, customer service agents, and logistics teams can utilize this API to enhance transparency and improve customer satisfaction. By integrating this API, users can streamline order management processes and provide timely updates to their clients.

get.summary: Track the status of an order.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the current tracking information of their orders by providing the necessary order details. It returns up-to-date status updates and estimated delivery times.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary information to track an order. Ensure that the order details are correctly formatted according to the schema defined in the components.

200.description: Order tracking request completed successfully, returning current status and details.

ListRetailOrdersTracksRequest.description: Represents the request body for the GET operations related to tracking orders. This is expected to be a string containing relevant tracking information.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the operation.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number of the order.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the order.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.
